evidence.title: Euroleague shareholders reject NBA Europe offer, door open for future talks

occurrences.checkable_against: NBA Europe launch plans and official league announcements
occurrences.quote_span: The rejection is a significant setback to efforts to combine Europe's established elite basketball competition with the financial and commercial power of the NBA, which plans to launch a 16-team NBA Europe league in 2027.

occurrences.subject: NBA Europe

evidence.title: NBA Europe plans continue after EuroLeague rejects merger

occurrences.checkable_against: EuroLeague membership-group statements and merger-vote records
occurrences.quote_span: Reports out of Europe have been that there’s dissension among the EuroLeague membership groups, with some franchises in favor of the merger and others against.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: NBA Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: NBA Europe format proposal and FIBA-affiliated domestic league qualification rules

occurrences.subject: NBA Europe

occurrences.checkable_against: EuroLeague benchmark-franchise statements and membership records
